    54→            # Apply projects filter if present

   834→    def _update_issue_with_status(

   836→    ) -> JiraIssue:
   837→        """
   838→        Update an issue with a status change.
   839→
   840→        Args:
   841→            issue_key: The key of the issue to update
   842→            fields: Dictionary of fields to update
   843→

   845→            JiraIssue model representing the updated issue
   846→

   848→            Exception: If there is an error updating the issue
   849→        """
   850→        # Extract status from fields and remove it for the standard update
   851→        status = fields.pop("status", None)
   852→
   853→        # First update any fields if needed
   854→        if fields:
   855→            self.jira.update_issue(issue_key=issue_key, fields=fields)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
   856→
   857→        # If no status change is requested, return the issue
   858→        if not status:
   859→            issue_data = self.jira.get_issue(issue_key)
   860→            return JiraIssue.from_api_response(issue_data)
   861→
   862→        # Get available transitions
   863→        transitions = self.get_available_transitions(issue_key)
   864→
   865→        # Extract status name or ID depending on what we received
   866→        status_name = None
   867→        status_id = None
   868→
   869→        # Handle different input formats for status
   870→        if isinstance(status, dict):
   871→            # Dictionary format: {"name": "In Progress"} or {"id": "123"}
   872→            status_name = status.get("name")
   873→            status_id = status.get("id")
   874→        elif isinstance(status, str):
   875→            # String format: could be a name or an ID
   876→            if status.isdigit():
   877→                status_id = status
   878→            else:
   879→                status_name = status
   880→        elif isinstance(status, int):
   881→            # Integer format: must be an ID
   882→            status_id = str(status)
   883→        else:
   884→            # Unknown format
   885→            logger.warning(
   886→                f"Unrecognized status format: {status} (type: {type(status)})"
   887→            )
   888→            status_name = str(status)
   889→
   890→        # Log what we're searching for
   891→        if status_name:
   892→            logger.info(f"Looking for transition to status name: '{status_name}'")
   893→        if status_id:
   894→            logger.info(f"Looking for transition with ID: '{status_id}'")
   895→
   896→        # Find the appropriate transition
   897→        transition_id = None
   898→        for transition in transitions:
   899→            to_status = transition.get("to", {})
   900→            transition_status_name = to_status.get("name", "")
   901→            transition_status_id = to_status.get("id")
   902→
   903→            # Match by name (case-insensitive)
   904→            if (
   905→                status_name
   906→                and transition_status_name
   907→                and transition_status_name.lower() == status_name.lower()
   908→            ):
   909→                transition_id = transition.get("id")
   910→                logger.info(
   911→                    f"Found transition ID {transition_id} matching status name '{status_name}'"
   912→                )
   913→                break
   914→
   915→            # Match by ID
   916→            if (
   917→                status_id
   918→                and transition_status_id
   919→                and str(transition_status_id) == str(status_id)
   920→            ):
   921→                transition_id = transition.get("id")
   922→                logger.info(
   923→                    f"Found transition ID {transition_id} matching status ID '{status_id}'"
   924→                )
   925→                break
   926→
   927→            # Direct transition ID match (if status is actually a transition ID)
   928→            if status_id and str(transition.get("id", "")) == str(status_id):
   929→                transition_id = transition.get("id")
   930→                logger.info(f"Using direct transition ID {transition_id}")
   931→                break
   932→
   933→        if not transition_id:
   934→            available_statuses = ", ".join(
   935→                [t.get("to", {}).get("name", "") for t in transitions]
   936→            )
   937→            error_msg = (
   938→                f"Could not find transition to status '{status}'. "
   939→                f"Available statuses: {available_statuses}"
   940→            )
   941→            logger.error(error_msg)
   942→            raise ValueError(error_msg)
   943→
   944→        # Perform the transition
   945→        logger.info(f"Performing transition with ID {transition_id}")
   946→        self.jira.set_issue_status_by_transition_id(
   947→            issue_key=issue_key,
   948→            transition_id=(
   949→                int(transition_id)
   950→                if isinstance(transition_id, str) and transition_id.isdigit()
   951→                else transition_id
   952→            ),
   953→        )
   954→
   955→        # Get the updated issue data
   956→        issue_data = self.jira.get_issue(issue_key)
   957→        return JiraIssue.from_api_response(issue_data)
